description: Fix CI: send a crew whose pull request has failing checks back to the Engineer to fix them on the same PR. Works from PR review (HIL_SHIP) or a HALTED/PAUSED crew that has a PR; refused when GitHub does not report CI as failing. Requires `approve` scope and spends crew tokens. Only call when the operator asks.

notes.description: Optional note for the Engineer, appended to the fix-CI brief.

outOfScope.description: Allow the Engineer to fix failures its work item did not cause (a flaky test elsewhere, a suite already red on the base branch) for this ONE round. Audited under your name. Only set true when the operator explicitly grants it.

name: anyforge_fix_crew_ci
title: Fix crew ci
